# attested claim

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestedClaim`](gmeow-attestedClaim.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedClaim>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The observation or claim that an attestation vouches for, when the subject of the attestation is itself a claim rather than a bare entity. Non-functional: an attestation may vouch for several related claims simultaneously.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) -> [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attestedClaim`](gmeow-attestedClaim.md) from [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) to [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md), [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link an attestation to the [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) it vouches for — the seam between the universal claim stack (what is asserted) and the attestation (who vouches for it under which policy).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a bare non-claim subject (use [`gmeow:attestedSubject`](gmeow-attestedSubject.md)) and avoid treating the attestation as making the claim true — it only records that the attester vouched for it; the claim's own modality stays on the [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint the claim as a [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) (or [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)) and point [`gmeow:attestedClaim`](gmeow-attestedClaim.md) at it; attach signature and log evidence to the [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md), and keep the claim's confidence and standpoint on the [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) rather than the envelope.

### Examples

- ex:credAtt [`gmeow:attestedClaim`](gmeow-attestedClaim.md) ex:degreeClaim.
